content.title: How to get Masters tickets: Prices, packages, and a CHEAP secret method
content.text: Getting tickets to the Masters isn’t easy – but it is possible. From official routes and ticket prices to hospitality packages and insider advice, here’s everything you need to know about securing tickets to Augusta National – including a sneaky method that hardly anyone knows about…If you’ve ever watched The Masters on TV and imagined walking those perfectly manicured fairways, you’re in good company. It’s one of the most coveted tickets in global sport – and for good reason.Compared to most of golf’s other big events, Augusta National keeps attendance relatively low. That’s part of what makes it so special on-site… but it also means demand massively outweighs supply. In simple terms: there just aren’t anywhere near enough tickets to go around. But don’t give up hope. We’ve detailed how you can get tickets to the Masters (which are probably a lot cheaper than you might think), some guaranteed ways to get them if you don’t get lucky in the ballot, and uncovered a secret method that could bag your entry to Augusta for peanuts, while seeing you play some of the best golf courses in the UK.The main route: The Masters ballotFor most people, the first (and most realistic) option is the official ticket lottery.Applications run from June 1-20 and, if you’re successful, payments are due in late July. Visit https://www.masters.com/en_US/tickets to create an account so you’re ready to apply when applications open.Masters ticket prices2027 Masters ticket prices haven’t been revealed yet, but are likely to be similar to 2026: Practice rounds (Mon–Wed): $100 Tournament days (Thu–Sun): $140 Four-day badge: $525 That headline number – $525 for all four days – is what surprises most people. Compared to other major sporting events, it’s actually pretty reasonable.The catch? Your chances. They’re slim. Demand is enormous, and even the most consistent applicants can try year-after-year without success. Didn’t win the ballot? Here’s Plan BIf the lottery doesn’t fall your way, don’t give up – just change approach (and start saving up!).There are several established tour operators who package Masters tickets with accommodation, hospitality, and golf experiences. It’s not cheap, but it is reliable.A few well-known options include: Premier Golf Golfbreaks Voyages.golf Sports & Entertainment Travel Halcyon Golf Travel Most packages start around $9,000–$12,000 depending on the level of luxury, length of stay, and extras like playing nearby courses.If you want a guaranteed route to The Masters, this is the route to take.A warning on resale ticketsIt’s tempting to browse secondary markets – but I wouldn’t risk it.Augusta National has a strict no-resale policy, and tickets bought unofficially can be cancelled without warning. In the worst-case scenario, you could spend a fortune, travel all the way to Georgia, and be turned away at the gate.Stick to official channels or reputable providers – it’s just not worth the gamble.The little-known route: Play your way to AugustaNow this is where it gets interesting.There’s a genuinely under-the-radar way to secure Masters tickets – and it starts on a golf course.It comes via an amateur event called the US Masters Texas Scramble.Here’s how it works: Open to club golfers across England, Scotland, and Wales with a WHS handicap Qualifiers run March through September 2026, and you can play as many as you like to try and secure your finals place Teams of four compete in a Texas Scramble format Win your qualifier and you reach a national final Win the final and you’re heading to Augusta The main prize is a dream: Five nights in Georgia Two rounds of golf Masters tickets And there’s more up for grabs: Waterproof suits GPS watches Rangefinders Weekends away at top UK golf resorts Entry fees are from around £20 per person.It might genuinely be the cheapest possible route to The Masters – if you’ve got the game (and the teammates) to pull it off.The best way to get Masters ticketsIf you are serious about going, the best plan is to: Enter the ballot every year Keep a package option in mind as a fallback – but be prepared for the cost Have a go at something like the Texas Scramble for a long-shot win Because that’s really what getting to Augusta is about – stacking the odds slightly more in your favour wherever you can.Is it worth all the effort?There’s no single easy way into The Masters. That’s exactly why it feels so special when you finally make it through the gates.But between the ballot, premium packages, and a few creative routes, it’s definitely more achievable than most people think – and it’s worth every bit of effort. 14 things you MUST know before attending the Masters at Augusta National Eyewitness: What it was like to watch Rory’s win up close
